arxiv-1702-01772.title: Generalised Mermin-type non-locality arguments
arxiv-1702-01772.creator: Stefano Gogioso, William Zeng
arxiv-1702-01772.description: A 2017 arXiv research paper by Stefano Gogioso, William Zeng. We broadly generalise Mermin-type arguments on GHZ states, and we provide exact group-theoretic conditions for non-locality to be achieved. Our results are of interest in quantum foundations, where they yield a new hierarchy of quantum-realisable All-vs-Nothing arguments. They are also of interest to quantum protocols, where they find immediate application to a non-trivial extension of the hybrid quantum-classical secret sharing scheme of Hillery, Bužek and Berthiaume (HBB).

arxiv-2106-07368.title: Quality-Aware Network for Face Parsing
arxiv-2106-07368.creator: Lu Yang, Qing Song, Xueshi Xin, Wenhe Jia, Zhiwei Liu
arxiv-2106-07368.description: Abstract This is a very short technical report, which introduces the solution of the Team BUPT-CASIA for Short-video Face Parsing Track of The 3rd Person in Context (PIC) Workshop and Challenge at CVPR 2021. Face parsing has recently attracted increasing interest due to its numerous application potentials.

arxiv-2108-09706.title: Magnetism of competing high-spin/low-spin states in Ba 2 NiO 2 (AgSe) 2 and related two-orbital two-electron systems
arxiv-2108-09706.creator: Rajiv R. P. Singh
arxiv-2108-09706.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Rajiv R. P. Singh. We discuss the thermodynamic and magnetic properties of a competing high-spin/low-spin two-orbital two-electron model on a square-lattice possibly relevant to the nickelates such as Ba 2 NiO 2 (AgSe) 2 (BNOAS). We focus on parameter regimes where a high-spin ( S = 1 S=1 ) and a low-spin ( S = 0 S=0 ) state are energetically close to each other and discuss various exchange processes in such a system.

arxiv-2205-10953.title: CYRUS Soccer Simulation 2D Team Description Paper 2022
arxiv-2205-10953.creator: Nader Zare, Arad Firouzkouhi, Omid Amini, Mahtab Sarvmaili, Aref Sayareh, Saba Ramezani Rad, Stan Matwin, Amilcar Soares
arxiv-2205-10953.description: Abstract Soccer Simulation 2D League is one of the major leagues of RoboCup competitions. In a Soccer Simulation 2D (SS2D) game, two teams of 11 players and one coach compete against each other. The players are only allowed to communicate with the server that is called Soccer Simulation Server.

arxiv-2412-12980.title: A Physics-Constrained Deep Learning Treatment of Runaway Electron Dynamics
arxiv-2412-12980.creator: Christopher J. McDevitt, Jonathan Arnaud, Xian-Zhu Tang
arxiv-2412-12980.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Christopher J. McDevitt, Jonathan Arnaud, Xian-Zhu Tang. An adjoint formulation leveraging a physics-informed neural network (PINN) is employed to advance the density moment of a runaway electron (RE) distribution forward in time. A distinguishing feature of this approach is that once the adjoint problem is solved, its solution can be used to project the RE density forward in time for an arbitrary initial momentum space distribution of REs. Furthermore, by employing a PINN, a parametric solution to the adjoint problem can be learned.

arxiv-2504-00132.title: Contextualize-then-Aggregate: Circuits for In-Context Learning in Gemma-2 2B
arxiv-2504-00132.creator: Aleksandra Bakalova, Yana Veitsman, Xinting Huang & Michael Hahn
arxiv-2504-00132.description: Abstract In-Context Learning (ICL) is an intriguing ability of large language models (LLMs). Despite a substantial amount of work on its behavioral aspects and how it emerges in miniature setups, it remains unclear which mechanism assembles task information from the individual examples in a few-shot prompt.

arxiv-2507-19230.title: Unstable Prompts, Unreliable Segmentations: A Challenge for Longitudinal Lesion Analysis
arxiv-2507-19230.creator: Niels Rocholl, Ewoud Smit, Mathias Prokop, Alessa Hering
arxiv-2507-19230.description: Abstract Longitudinal lesion analysis is crucial for oncological care, yet automated tools often struggle with temporal consistency. While universal lesion segmentation models have advanced, they are typically designed for single time points. This paper investigates the performance of the ULS23 segmentation model in a longitudinal context.

arxiv-2509-22380.title: Multidimensional Uncertainty Quantification via Optimal Transport
arxiv-2509-22380.creator: Nikita Kotelevskii 1 Maiya Goloburda 1 Vladimir Kondratyev 1 Alexander Fishkov 1 Mohsen Guizani 1 Eric Moulines 2,1 Maxim Panov 1 1 Department of Machine Learning, MBZUAI, UAE 2 CMAP, École Polytechnique, France {nikita.kotelevskii, maxim.panov}@mbzuai.ac.ae
arxiv-2509-22380.description: Abstract Most uncertainty quantification (UQ) approaches provide a single scalar value as a measure of model reliability. However, different uncertainty measures could provide complementary information on the prediction confidence. Even measures targeting the same type of uncertainty (e.g., ensemble-based and density-based measures of epistemic uncertainty) may capture different failure modes.

The project delivered a full systems design, component selection, and production and test plans for a near-zero-emission, Tier 5–capable

pmc-10547827.title: The Feasibility of Using Tri-Exponential Intra-Voxel Incoherent Motion DWI for Identifying the Microvascular Invasion in Hepatocellular Carcinoma
pmc-10547827.creator: Yunfei Zhang, Ruofan Sheng, Chun Yang, Yongming Dai, Mengsu Zeng
pmc-10547827.description: PurposeTo assess the effectiveness of tri-exponential Intra-Voxel Incoherent Motion (tri-IVIM) MRI in preoperatively identifying microvascular invasion (MVI) in hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC).Patients and MethodsIn this prospective study, 67 patients with HCC were included. Metrics from bi-exponential IVIM (bi-IVIM) and tri-IVIM were calculated. Subgroup comparisons were analyzed using the independent Student’s t-test or Mann–Whitney U-test.

pmc-10616680.title: Ambiguous Genitalia: An Unexpected Diagnosis in a Newborn
pmc-10616680.creator: Ana Losa, Juliana Da Silva Cardoso, Sara Leite, Ana Cristina Barros, Ana Guedes, Cidade Rodrigues, Teresa Borges, Natália Oliva-Teles, Ana Rita Soares, Céu Mota
pmc-10616680.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Alterations in gonad formation or function can lead to congenital conditions in which chromosomal, gonadal, or anatomical sex is atypical. These conditions are referred to as disorders of sex development (DSD) and have a heterogeneous etiology. The assessment of these children by a multidisciplinary team is crucial for an accurate diagnosis and should be initiated promptly due to the potentially life-threatening nature of congenital adrenal hyperplasia, a common cause of DSD.

pmc-10671430.title: Sulfated Polysaccharides as a Fighter with Protein Non-Physiological Aggregation: The Role of Polysaccharide Flexibility and Charge Density
pmc-10671430.creator: Olga N. Makshakova, Liliya R. Bogdanova, Dzhigangir A. Faizullin, Elena A. Ermakova, Yuriy F. Zuev
pmc-10671430.description: Proteins can lose native functionality due to non-physiological aggregation. In this work, we have shown the power of sulfated polysaccharides as a natural assistant to restore damaged protein structures. Protein aggregates enriched by cross-β structures are a characteristic of amyloid fibrils related to different health disorders.

pmc-11437556.title: A Case of Autoimmune progesterone dermatitis post-intrauterine device placement in rural occupied Palestine
pmc-11437556.creator: Ibrahim Alheeh, Neveen Shalalfeh, Shatha Wajeeh, Rou’a Farah, Rahaf Farah
pmc-11437556.description: Autoimmune progesterone dermatitis is considered a rare cyclical autoimmune reaction to endogenous progesterone in fertile females that is characterized by skin lesions ranging from mild urticaria to anaphylaxis. A 30-year-old woman who had an intrauterine device placed, presented to her family medicine clinic with erythema and some edematous lesions, and pruritus.

pmc-11593001.title: Simultaneous Stimulation of Peripheral Blood Mononuclear Cells with CpG ODN2006 and α-IgM Antibodies Leads to Strong Immune Responses in Monocytes Independent of B Cell Activation
pmc-11593001.creator: Leonie Fleige, Silvia Capellino, John W Chen
pmc-11593001.description: CpG ODN2006 is widely used both in vitro and in vivo to achieve B cell activation and has been previously applied in clinical trials as an adjuvant and anti-cancer agent. Recent studies have demonstrated the benefit of combining CpG ODN2006 with α-IgM antibodies to obtain optimal B cell activation in vitro.

pmc-11675390.title: B Chromosome Transcriptional Inactivation in the Spermatogenesis of the Grasshopper Eyprepocnemis plorans
pmc-11675390.creator: Juan Luis Santos, María Teresa Parra, Sara Arévalo, Andrea Guajardo-Grence, Jesús Page, José Ángel Suja, Carlos García de la Vega, Alberto Viera
pmc-11675390.description: Background/Objectives: We analyzed the relationship between synapsis, recombination, and transcription during the spermatogenesis of the grasshopper Eyprepocnemis plorans carrying B chromosomes (type B1). Methods: The progression of synapsis was interpreted according to the dynamics of the cohesin subunit SMC3 axes.

pmc-12508998.title: Thermally Robust Plasmonic Nanorings from Titanium Nitride
pmc-12508998.creator: Xavier Baami González, Paul Maurice Leidinger, Bruno Rente, Ryan Bower, Jeppe V. Lauritsen, Peter K. Petrov, Duncan S. Sutherland
pmc-12508998.description: Plasmonic nanostructures are widely utilized in fields such as chemical sensing, photothermal therapy, and optoelectronics due to their ability to confine and enhance electromagnetic fields at the nanoscale. Among these, nanorings offer unique advantages owing to their hollow-core geometry, which supports multiple plasmonic modes and enables efficient analyte access.

pmc-12926657.title: Dietary change revealed in kitchen refuse pits from the ancient floors of Housepit 54, K'etxelknáz (Bridge River Site), British Columbia
pmc-12926657.creator: Anna Marie Prentiss, Ashley Hampton, Jeannie Larmon, Megan Denis, Thomas A. Foor, Haley O'Brien, Nathan Goodale, Matthew J. Walsh, Alysha Edwards, Joshua Jack, Ethan Ryan
pmc-12926657.description: IntroductionDietary change in traditional fishing and foraging societies has been examined from standpoints of resource accessibility, population demands, and social needs. Typically, scholars focus on singular models to explain diet choice including those from optimal foraging theory, socio-ecology, and political and historical ecology.

pmc-13385958.title: Tea-inspired curing modulates chemical composition, volatile aroma, and sensory quality of flue-cured tobacco leaves
pmc-13385958.creator: Yukun Liu, Zhenxie Yi, Xianhai Yang, Keqin Li, Dong Wang, Zhijun Xu, Junfeng Chen, Linjian Dai
pmc-13385958.description: Curing largely determines the usability and style of tobacco. Drawing on tea processing, we developed three methods using fresh tobacco leaves: a black tea–like process with wilting, rolling, fermentation, and drying (TR), and two green tea key steps that replace rolling with steaming (TZ) or pan-firing (TC) to shape distinct aroma styles, and these were compared with conventional flue-curing (CK).

pmc-13711656.title: Large-scale identification and evolutionary analysis of ATP-binding cassette transporters in cross-lineage plant species
pmc-13711656.creator: Kangkang Song, Yinuo Zhao, He Xu, Haozhen Li, Xiaohua Zhang, Yanru Song, Boyuan Liu, Jingyu Wang, Bin Tan, Zhe Zhang, Bin Li, Wenjing Liu, Yiying Qi, Long Yang
pmc-13711656.description: The ATP-binding cassette (ABC) gene family plays a crucial role in plants by mediating the transport of various molecules, contributing to development, stress responses, and secondary metabolism. Here, 159077ABC genes were identified from 1108 plant species. Comparative analysis revealed that higher plants had more ABC genes compared to algae plants.
